We propose a novel zero-shot LLM method that generates the entire temporal graph in a single inference step. Our method prompts the model to produce a free-form summary of the event timeline to guide reasoning or "thinking", followed by classification of all event pairs...

temporal graphs with relations (before, after, equal, vague) between event pairs
